build_autoencoder_kl_magvit: build a video autoencoder model using AutoencoderKLMagvit with causal 3D convolutions for video latent encoding and decoding
create_causal_conv3d_layer: create an EasyAnimateCausalConv3d layer that performs temporally causal 3D convolution with replicate padding for video frames
encode_video_to_latents: encode a batch of video frames into latent representations using AutoencoderKLMagvit encode method with diagonal Gaussian distribution
decode_latents_to_video: decode video latent tensors back to pixel space using AutoencoderKLMagvit decode method with framewise processing
enable_tiled_vae_decoding: enable tiled encoding and decoding on AutoencoderKLMagvit to process large video frames with reduced memory usage
